column5: - Requirement signatures: `TT/callable_applications.rs:6386-6394` (closed view returned with no scope check when no requirement application was written); `:6573-6587` (runtime-value binding ignored); `:6548-6559, 6779-6781, 6821-6823` (nothing prepared, no error); `:7370-7376, 7400-7414` (unbound lifetime names and symbols pass through unchanged); `:7459-7475` (`instantiated: None` stored); `:7629` (elided lifetimes); `:346-375` (a call to an unsubstituted machine parameter is left as it was); `:976-1018`; `:1066-1071` (unknown domain keeps its old identity); `:3660` (unlisted expression kinds copied without substituting types inside).

- Calls: `TT/calls_and_control_flow.rs:267` (a contract symbol not found in nine tables is treated as public for dynamic eligibility); `:1130-1139` (runtime binders that match no formal give natural order, no error); `:1647-1649`; `:2875-2879, 3407-3414` (`static_machine_parameter` copied but not remapped); `:3192` (non-return statements ignored when collecting "direct" return values).

- Tables: `DTI:2373-2375` (a trait implementation application whose scope cannot be rebuilt is kept); `:2358`; `:4222-4224` (a machine with no authored target is returned for every target string; code confirmed); `:1698-1779` (lookups without an `is_valid` guard match invalid-symbol rows; pinned by a test); `:4539-4541` (unlisted symbol kind reads as "no type parameters"); `:1581-1609` (the cache key sum leaves out five tables).

- Declarations: `TT/declarations.rs:113` (invalid or duplicated completion row falls to `NormalReturn`); `:55` (family disagreement gives `NormalReturn`); `:312` (second `Calling` trait in a file overwrites the first); `:1088-1096` (unrecognised name becomes an open `binder:` identity, not an error); `:1527-1535` (kinds outside the list count as closed, including `PropositionMachineParameter`); `:972-973` (`zip` truncates mismatched argument lists); `:2069-2086` (unresolved `invokes` targets dropped); `:2199-2212`.

- Access views: `TT/access_views_and_commitments.rs:1972-1977` (`admits_fixed_index` is `true` for any index when the extent is a recipe; one caller accepts on true); `:357-370` (right name, different bytes: treated as an ordinary declaration); `:479-493, 768-776` (toolchain file at the path trusted without a byte compare); `:2178`.

- Type identity and contexts: `TT/type_identity.rs:7850` (in a statically unreachable context any two types match; code confirmed); `:326-330` (two callables whose derivation failed share the default invalid id); `:7654-7711` (uninterned identity becomes `""`); `:5765, 5823-5842`; `:7485` (invalid `retained` handle accepted); `:552`; `TT/type_system.rs:760-767` with `:1889-1890` (if a producer wrongly records zero worlds the construct is treated as dead and its mismatches are not reported; producers of `reachable` not read); `:884`.

- Expressions: `TT/values.rs:4065-4097` (structural equality ignores `case_variant`, machine arguments, dispatch and build selection); `:112-130` (accepts a division-by-zero shape); `:5183-5260` (subtree search cannot see static arguments or `nonempty_view`); `:5046` (case view through a non-local name classified as fields); `:2279-2283`.

- References: `TT/references.rs:164-166` (non-call expression: no stamping, no error); `:241-305` (the `complete` flag is dropped by every caller in the file); `:3117-3143` (call fields not listed are not visited).
